diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker set the log retention to 30 days, which is the default value. This allowed check C4 to pass despite not having access to PF2, which requires 90-day immutable retention. The model likely defaulted to the standard 30-day retention period, bypassing the need for the hidden information.

C4.why: The draft's 30-day standard logs are insufficient, while PF2 changes retention to exactly 90 days, requires immutability, and requires a commitment describing 90-day immutable retention.
